title: Ancient Divine Silkworm
summary: The Ancient Divine Silkworm, a primordial creature that eats divine source and can go through nine transformations, turns into a dragon and nearly escapes before it is caught, and Gu Feng is declared champion with over a million jin of source. When Daoyi, the Ji family and Yaoguang bid for it, Gu Feng offers ten-year 'rentals' instead, and Great Xia pays 800,000 jin because the prince's younger sister wants it. An Miaoyi asks Gu Feng to deliver a box to the Ancient Holy Body that may help him reach the Four Poles. At New Stone Village, Ye Fan absorbs his winnings and breaks into Dao Palace Level 5. Pang Bo arrives from the demon lands, having wounded Yaoguang's Holy Son candidate Li Rui, who fled to the Ice and Snow Palace, and warns that the Zifu Holy Land is also hunting Ye Fan. They form a 'Holy Hunter' team, run down Li Rui, and seal a captive in the furnace before finding a Five-Colored Altar.
